title: Structural basis of transcription activation by Rob, a pleiotropic AraC/XylS family regulator.
authors: Shi, Jing; Wang, Fulin; Li, Fangfang; Wang, Lu; Xiong, Ying; Wen, Aijia; Jin, Yuanling; Jin, Sha; Gao, Fei; Feng, Zhenzhen; Li, Jiacong; Zhang, Yu; Shang, Zhuo; Wang, Shuang; Feng, Yu; Lin, Wei
one_liner_zh: 该文通过冷冻电镜结构解析了AraC/XylS家族转录因子Rob与RNA聚合酶及启动子DNA的转录激活复合物，虽聚焦结构生物学而非AI/MD方法，但提供了TF-DNA结合与弯曲机制的关键结构信息，对理解TF-DNA互作建模有参考价值。
abstract: Rob, which serves as a paradigm of the large AraC/XylS family transcription activators, regulates diverse subsets of genes involved in multidrug resistance and stress response. However, the underlying mechanism of how it engages bacterial RNA polymerase and promoter DNA to finely respond to environmental stimuli is still elusive. Here, we present two cryo-EM structures of Rob-dependent transcription activation complex (Rob-TAC) comprising of Escherichia coli RNA polymerase (RNAP), Rob-regulated promoter and Rob in alternative conformations. The structures show that a single Rob engages RNAP by interacting with RNAP alphaCTD and sigma70R4, revealing their generally important regulatory roles. Notably, by occluding sigma70R4 from binding to -35 element, Rob specifically binds to the conserved Rob binding box through its consensus HTH motifs, and retains DNA bending by aid of the accessory acidic loop. More strikingly, our ligand docking and biochemical analysis demonstrate that the large Rob C-terminal domain (Rob CTD) shares great structural similarity with the global Gyrl-like domains in effector binding and allosteric regulation, and coordinately promotes formation of competent Rob-TAC. Altogether, our structural and biochemical data highlight the detailed molecular mechanism of Rob-dependent transcription activation, and provide favorable evidences for understanding the physiological roles of the other AraC/XylS-family transcription factors.
abstract_zh: Rob作为AraC/XylS家族大转录激活因子的代表，调控涉及多药耐药和应激反应的多类基因子集。然而，其如何与细菌RNA聚合酶及启动子DNA相互作用以精细响应环境刺激的潜在机制仍不明确。在此，我们展示了两种Rob依赖性转录激活复合物（Rob-TAC）的冷冻电镜结构，该复合物包含大肠杆菌RNA聚合酶（RNAP）、Rob调控的启动子及处于不同构象的Rob。结构显示，单个Rob通过与RNAP的alphaCTD和sigma70R4相互作用来结合RNAP，揭示了它们普遍重要的调控作用。值得注意的是，通过阻止sigma70R4与-35元件的结合，Rob通过其保守的HTH基序特异性地结合到保守的Rob结合盒，并借助辅助酸性环维持DNA弯曲。更为显著的是，我们的配体对接和生化分析表明，大的Rob C端结构域（Rob CTD）在效应物结合和变构调控方面与全局Gyrl样结构域具有高度结构相似性，并协同促进功能性Rob-TAC的形成。总之，我们的结构和生化数据强调了Rob依赖性转录激活的详细分子机制，并为理解其他AraC/XylS家族转录因子的生理作用提供了有利证据。
